_comment: Client-facing copy. Edit freely - the bot re-reads this file on every draft.
{placeholder} is filled from the Trello card. [[ ... ]] wraps an optional
chunk that disappears when a placeholder inside it is empty, so a card
without a launch time or hub link still reads naturally.
Available: agentMention, agentName, clientName, campaignLabel, teamName,
sms: Hi[[ {agentName}]], this is {teamName}. Your {campaignLabel} is complete and ready to go live {goLiveShort}[[ at {goLiveTime}]][[ {timezoneLabel}]]. Your sheet: {sheetUrl} Please reply to confirm the launch date works for you. Thanks!
smsNudge: Hi[[ {agentName}]], following up from {teamName} - your setup is ready to go live {goLiveShort}. Details are in your Discord channel. Please reply here to confirm the date works. Thanks!
